quarterly_data.signal: DoD award: single-award, firm-fixed-price IDIQ contract N66001-26-D-0020 to Oracle America, Inc. (Austin, Texas) under the Department of War Enterprise Software Initiative (DOW ESI), for a five-year ordering period; lets customers across the DOW — and the intelligence community and the Coast Guard — procure Oracle software licenses (perpetual and subscription), maintenance and support renewals, software as a service, customer success services and Oracle consulting services; an unexercised option would raise cumulative value to $6,990,000,000; non-competitive direct award authorized by the Secretary of the Navy in the public interest; no funds obligated at award; contracting activity Naval Information Warfare Center Pacific, San Diego.
quarterly_data.figure: $3,311,000,000 IDIQ contract (five-year ordering period); up to $6,990,000,000 with option
